description: Lock or unlock the device screen. lock shows the lock screen and leaves a locked screen alone; unlock dismisses it back to the app that was in front. Each returns once the device reports that lock state. Android locks with KEYCODE_SLEEP and unlocks with KEYCODE_WAKEUP then wm dismiss-keyguard, verified by the keyguard state dumpsys window reports; a screen lock set to None is refused with lock-screen-disabled, and unlock always sends the wake event, which leaves a screen that is on unchanged. iPhone and iPad simulators lock through the XCUITest lock button, verified by the SpringBoard lock state and a lock screen surface, and unlock with a swipe up from the bottom edge after the lock button wakes a dark screen; unlock also needs the screen on. A PIN, pattern, password, or passcode lock is never unlocked: unlock refuses with reason lock-screen-secure and types nothing. The session app is not activated, so verify with screenshot; an app-scoped command such as snapshot can bring the app back to the front on iOS. Every other target refuses this command, including physical iPhones and iPads and Android TV. Times out after 90s.

action.description: lock shows the lock screen; unlock dismisses a lock screen that asks for no credential.
